summary: Master education project management and donor compliance. Build logframes, manage grant budgets, and produce audit-ready reports. Enrol at TrainingCred.com.
lede: Managing donor-funded education projects combines work planning, financial controls, monitoring, and donor reporting. For programme staff and people moving into grants or monitoring and evaluation roles, this course addresses the practical task of connecting approved budgets and project activities to documented results. You will practise building work plans and logical frameworks, tracking budget variances and reconciling expenditure, and designing indicator-based monitoring systems and audit-ready reports.
audienceIntro: This course is built for mid-career professionals who are already working on donor-funded education programmes and need to strengthen their project management rigour, compliance confidence, and reporting capability. It is equally relevant to those stepping into a grants management or M&E role for the first time and to experienced programme staff who want to formalise and systematise what they have learned on the job.
modules: Logical Framework and Theory of Change Design
Grant Budget Management and Financial Controls
Donor Compliance, Procurement, and Sub-Award Management
Donor Reporting, Dashboards, and Programme Closure
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel and a web browser installed. KoBoToolbox (free account) and Power BI Desktop (free version) will be used during hands-on sessions — installation guides are provided in the pre-course pack. Participants are encouraged to bring a copy of a current or recent grant agreement from their organisation to use as a reference document during exercises, though sample grant instruments will be provided for those who cannot share organisational documents.
